description: Alternating background shades with gradient transitions between sections
implementation_hint: Alternate between 2-3 dark shades (e.g. #0C0322 → #1a1a2e → #0f0f23) with soft gradient blends at section boundaries

description: Subtle noise or dot-grid pattern layered behind sections
implementation_hint: CSS noise pattern or SVG dot-grid at low opacity (0.03-0.08). Adds tactile depth without distraction

description: Radial gradient blobs positioned behind content sections
implementation_hint: Large soft radial gradients (brand colours at 10-20% opacity) offset from centre. Creates atmosphere without competing with content

description: Subtle scroll offset on background elements creating layered depth
implementation_hint: Background shapes move at 0.3-0.5x scroll speed. Foreground stays fixed. Creates spatial depth

description: Massive display type vs small body text creating strong visual weight contrast
implementation_hint: Display headlines at 4-6rem with tight letter-spacing. Body at 1rem-1.125rem. The gap creates hierarchy without colour

description: Large standalone numbers in cards rather than inline statistics
implementation_hint: Numbers at 3-4rem bold in cards. Labels below at 0.875rem. Grid layout 3-4 across

description: Small coloured label chips for categories or session types
implementation_hint: Pill-shaped badges with category colour + white text. Consistent per category across page

description: Full-bleed image cards with overlay text instead of text-only cards
implementation_hint: Image fills card. Dark gradient overlay bottom 40%. Name and title over gradient. Rounded corners

description: Thin coloured strip on card edge indicating category
implementation_hint: 3-4px left border or top border in category colour. Subtle but scannable

description: Cards lift and shadow deepens on hover
implementation_hint: translateY(-4px) + shadow increase on hover. 200ms ease transition

description: Backdrop-blur frosted glass effect on image overlays
implementation_hint: backdrop-filter: blur(12px) + semi-transparent background. Adds depth without hiding content

description: Visual phase bands replacing flat timeline lists
implementation_hint: Colour-coded phase bands (Morning/Midday/Afternoon/Evening). Each phase has distinct background shade and label

description: Testimonials and social proof placed near CTAs not buried at page bottom
where_to_apply: Testimonials repositioned near pricing or CTA sections
implementation_hint: Pull 1-2 strongest quotes into a callout block directly above or beside the primary CTA

description: Mixed column-span grids instead of uniform card grids
implementation_hint: Grid with mixed spans: some cards 2-col some 1-col. Creates visual rhythm and hierarchy within the grid

description: Text on one side and visual on the other instead of centred stack
implementation_hint: Left-aligned headline + subtext + CTA. Right side: product screenshot or visual. 50/50 or 60/40 split

description: Numbers animate counting up when they enter the viewport
implementation_hint: IntersectionObserver triggers count animation from 0 to target. Duration 1.5-2s with easing

description: Elements fade up with staggered delay as they scroll into view
where_to_apply: All card sections and content blocks
implementation_hint: Each child element delays 50-100ms after previous. Fade from opacity 0 + translateY(20px). IntersectionObserver trigger

description: Glow shadow increases in intensity on hover
implementation_hint: box-shadow glow radius and opacity increase on hover. 300ms transition. Pairs with existing glow-card system

description: Subtle pulse or glow animation on primary call-to-action button
implementation_hint: Gentle box-shadow pulse animation (2s infinite). Not bouncing — just glow breathing. Draws eye without annoying

description: Icon state transitions with opacity + scale + blur combination
implementation_hint: opacity: 0→1, scale: 0.25→1, filter: blur(4px→0px). 200ms cubic-bezier. Combine all three for polished icon swap

description: Mathematically correct nested border radius (outer = inner + padding)
where_to_apply: Cards inside cards and nested rounded containers
implementation_hint: Calculate outer radius from inner radius + padding gap. Prevents the 'pinched corner' look on nested elements

description: Multiple transparent shadow layers replacing single solid borders
where_to_apply: Cards, elevated surfaces, and section dividers
implementation_hint: 2-3 box-shadow layers at different offsets and opacities. E.g. 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,0.07), 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.05). More natural than borders

description: Antialiased font rendering for crisper text on dark backgrounds
implementation_hint: -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased. Prevents subpixel rendering which blurs text on dark backgrounds. Apply globally

description: Audit page against anti-patterns.csv — check for generic AI fonts/colors/layouts/decorations
implementation_hint: Score each row in anti-patterns.csv as PASS/FAIL. Flag: default fonts, pure colors, card-in-card, unjustified decoration, same-grid-everywhere

description: Audit page against performance.csv — estimate Core Web Vitals and check asset optimization
implementation_hint: Score against LCP/CLS/INP thresholds. Check: image sizes/formats, font loading, render-blocking resources, bundle size, code-splitting
